dct_description_sm: The GIS database provides in depth information on each stream including potential abundance, key area of concern, Traditional Ecological Knowledge (TEK), and additional comments. In Nunavik, more than 200 streams provide the Inuit with Arctic charr.  The increasing need for the supply of country food has placed pressure on charr stocks.  Efforts are being made by the communities to enhance and manage their local charr stocks, e.g. Nepihjee River near Kuujjuaq in Quebec.  The GIS database will serve as a tool for the active management of charr systems in the face of increased exploitation and perturbations caused by climate change. Ongoing efforts are being made to operationalize access to the database so that it can be accessed and updated on an ongoing basis from all communities.
dct_title_s: Nunavik Arctic Char Stream Enhancement GIS Database
